description: Election Commission - Declare that a member of the Ambalangoda, Ambagamuwa, Pradeshiya Sabhas has Vacated his Office of member
reasoning: This gazette content contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of Pradeshiya Sabhas due to ceasing to be members of a political party. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including vacancies and declarations related to local authority elections.
